source: a lower bound, not the engine's rate: vLLM at TP8 on 8 H200s with a 131,072-token context limit, sent the 128k plan's first 651 requests at the plan's own 0.4 a second (the run's `record` arm); it kept up and served every one, so nothing shows what a higher rate would compute. Computed tokens are the engine's own count, prompt tokens less those its prefix cache served plus output tokens (2,174,492), over the pass's wall seconds on 8 GPUs (1,494.9 s); benchmarks/serve_tax's schedule record
